description: Capability for dexel's single main window. Deliberately minimal: the page the webview loads is dexel's own loopback server, which talks to the Go backend over plain HTTP/WebSocket and never uses Tauri IPC. There is no `remote` field, so that http://127.0.0.1:<port> origin is granted NOTHING through Tauri's ACL. The one allowed sidecar is `binaries/Dexel` -- the bundled Go daemon, whose CAPITALISED name is load-bearing and whose collision hazard with the shell's own main binary is guarded by a test; see SIDECAR_NAME in ../src/lib.rs.
